jobs.title: Move/rotate an entity
jobs.jobSummary: Change the position and rotation of one existing scene entity to new values and see the result in the running scene.

jobs.title: Retune a material
jobs.jobSummary: Adjust scalar parameters of an existing material (e.g. roughness, emissive intensity) until the surface reads correctly.

jobs.title: Rebind an input action
jobs.jobSummary: Point an existing named input action at a different physical control without changing the action's gameplay meaning.

jobs.title: Edit a clip event marker
jobs.jobSummary: Move an event marker on an existing animation clip to a different timestamp so the triggered effect lines up with the motion.

jobs.title: Resize/relayout a HUD element
jobs.jobSummary: Change the size and anchoring of one existing HUD element so it fits a new layout without overlapping its neighbors.
